title: Polyxd UI document
description: A just-in-time interface: a flat list of semantic components (A2UI-style adjacency list) plus the surface it belongs to. Data comes from the host via bindings; actions are declared capability intents. Generated file: edit components/*.json and schema/common.defs.json instead.

title.description: Short title for the surface (page title / dialog title)

intent.description: What the user is trying to do, as a stable key (e.g. 'money.send'); memory is organised by intent

pattern.description: Id of the pattern this surface follows, when one applies

journey.description: Id of the journey this surface is a step of, when one applies

subtitle.description: One line under the title: what this record or page is

breadcrumbs.description: Where this surface sits, ending with its parent (the title is the last step)

badge.description: Status of the thing this surface is about, e.g. 'Past due'

avatar.description: Initials or a media reference for the entity this surface is about

actions.description: ActionBar in the header: what you can do to this record

presentation.description: 'panel' opens beside what it came from (a side sheet over a list) and is full screen on compact surfaces

data.description: Host data snapshot. Supplied by the host (or a test fixture), never by the model.

Id.description: Component id, unique within the document

Key.description: Stable semantic key (e.g. 'fee', 'recipient.name'). The same thing gets the same key across generations; interface memory uses it to keep placement, order and labels consistent.

Path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into host-provided data. Absolute ('/account/balance') or, inside a template, relative to the current item ('amount').

Binding.description: A value read from (and, for inputs, written to) host data. Data always comes from the host; the model never invents it.

Format.description: How to present a value. The renderer localizes it; the model never pre-formats numbers or dates into strings.

label.description: Accessible name, when the visible label is absent or insufficient

Accessibility.description: Same fields as A2UI v1.0 'accessibility'. Components already carry roles and names from their semantics; use this only to add to them.

Capability.description: Name of a host-registered capability (e.g. 'transfer.confirm'). The 'ui.' namespace is reserved for renderer-handled actions: ui.dismiss, ui.back, ui.next.

context.description: Values sent with the event, usually bindings to inputs or to the current template item

Action.description: A declared intent. The host binds it to a handler; generated UI never runs code. Same shape as A2UI 'action.event'.

path.description: Array in host data to repeat over

componentId.description: Component rendered once per item; relative paths inside it resolve against the item

Template.description: Same shape as A2UI templated children

avatarPath.description: Initials or a media reference per option: renders people and places with a face

recentPath.description: Boolean per option: shown in a 'Recent' row above the full list

Options.description: Either a fixed list, or options read from host data

ComponentAction.description: A button that triggers a host capability.

label.description: Verb-first label saying what happens ('Send £20', not 'OK')

ComponentActionBar.description: The set of actions for a surface or section; the renderer places it where that platform expects.

children.description: Action component ids, in order of importance

ComponentCard.description: One self-contained entity (an account, an order, a place), optionally actionable as a whole.

action.description: Activating the card as a whole (e.g. open details)

value.description: Number from 0 to 1 in host data

label.description: Optional text, e.g. '120 of 320 pages'; the percentage is shown otherwise

progress.description: Progress through the entity (reading, a course, a goal)

ComponentChart.description: A visual summary of data, always paired with a text summary.

intent.description: What the chart should communicate; the renderer picks the chart type

data.description: Array of data points in host data

ComponentChoice.description: Pick one or several options from a known set. The renderer chooses the control.

ComponentCollection.description: A list of items from host data, each rendered with the same template.

label.description: What the list contains, e.g. 'Recent payments'

empty.description: Status component shown when there are no items

selected.description: Selected item value(s) in host data when selection is not 'none'

layout.description: 'grid' for visual items (products, books); 'list' for rows; 'timeline' for dated activity; 'auto' lets the renderer choose from the item template

ComponentComparison.description: Compare a few options across the same attributes, and choose one.

items.description: Array of options in host data (2–4 recommended)

itemTitle.description: Relative path to each item's name

choose.description: Action per item; context bindings resolve against the item

recommended.description: Optional value of the recommended item's title, with a reason in 'summary'

recommendedReason.description: Why the recommended item fits, shown on its badge (one short sentence)

ComponentConfirm.description: Asks the user to confirm a consequential or destructive action, showing what will happen.

title.description: Question naming the action ('Send £250 to Alex?')

consequence.description: What happens and whether it can be undone

summary.description: Optional DetailList summarising what is being confirmed

typeToConfirm.description: Text the user must type before confirming (for irreversible, high-impact actions)

amount.description: The amount being committed, shown large at the top

avatar.description: Initials, or a media reference in host data

subject.description: Who or what the action is for, shown with a face or picture

consequences.description: What will happen, as a short list (for destructive actions)

ComponentDateInput.description: A date, time, date-time or date range.

ComponentDetailList.description: Label/value pairs describing one thing (a summary, a receipt, a review step).

total.description: The total row of a receipt, shown emphasised after a divider

variant.description: 'receipt' for money: values right-aligned in tabular figures, with an optional total row

layout.description: 'grid' packs many short fields into columns (record pages); 'rows' keeps one per line

ComponentDisclosure.description: Progressive disclosure: secondary content hidden behind a toggle.

summary.description: Always-visible label describing what is hidden

ComponentFilterPanel.description: Filters for a list of results, with the result count.

children.description: The filter inputs (Choice, RangeInput, Toggle, DateInput, TextInput)

results.description: The Collection or Table the filters narrow

resultCount.description: Number of results with the current filters, from host data

clear.description: Optional action that resets the filters on the host

ComponentForm.description: Collects inputs and submits them together.

cancel.description: Optional; defaults to ui.dismiss when omitted and the surface is dismissible

aside.description: Optional summary (DetailList, Card or Group) kept beside the form, e.g. the running total

layout.description: 'horizontal' puts label and help on the left and the control on the right (settings pages), on wide surfaces

ComponentGroup.description: Visually groups closely related items without a heading (proximity).

label.description: Accessible name for the group when it isn't obvious from its content

arrangement.description: Hint only. 'inline' for a few short peers (e.g. metrics); renderers stack on narrow screens.

ComponentMedia.description: An image supplied by the host.

src.description: Image reference in host data; generated UI never contains URLs

ComponentMetric.description: A key figure with a label, and optionally its change.

favorable.description: Which direction is good, so color follows meaning, not sign

badge.description: Count needing attention, e.g. overdue invoices

current.description: Key of the current item in host data

ComponentRangeInput.description: A number, or a range between two numbers, within known bounds.

value.description: Number in host data, or [min, max] when mode is 'range'

mode.description: 'range' picks a lower and upper bound; value is then [min, max]

ComponentSection.description: A titled region of the surface that groups related content under a heading.

description.description: Optional one-line explanation under the heading

ComponentStatus.description: Feedback about state: info, success, warning, error, empty or loading.

action.description: Optional Action (or ActionBar for a primary and a secondary) to recover or continue, e.g. 'Try again'; for 'undo', the Undo action

icon.description: Optional icon for empty states; the renderer picks one by kind otherwise

variant.description: 'inline' is a notice inside a page (a warning above a record) rather than a block of its own

ComponentSteps.description: A task split into ordered steps with visible progress.

ComponentTable.description: Tabular data: many items sharing the same attributes.

rows.description: Array of row objects in host data

caption.description: What the table shows (required for accessibility)

kind.description: What the cell holds; drives alignment, tabular figures and status tags

align.description: Overrides the alignment the kind implies

sortable.description: Whether people can sort by this column

avatarPath.description: For 'entity': relative path to the picture or initials

secondaryPath.description: For 'entity': a second line, e.g. an email address

rowAction.description: Activated per row; context bindings resolve against the row

empty.description: Status component shown when there are no rows

column.description: Key of the sorted column in host data

action.description: Sent when someone sorts, so the host can re-query

sort.description: Sorting state, owned by the host

selection.description: 'multiple' adds a checkbox column and a select-all

selected.description: Array of selected row values in host data

rowValuePath.description: Relative path to each row's id, used for selection

bulkActions.description: ActionBar shown instead of the toolbar while rows are selected

rowActions.description: ActionBar offered per row, in a menu named after the row

toolbar.description: ActionBar above the table (e.g. New, Import, Export)

filters.description: FilterPanel whose filters narrow this table

views.description: Saved views (All, Mine, Past due…), shown as tabs with counts

view.description: Key of the selected saved view in host data

total.description: Total number of rows, all pages

action.description: Sent when someone changes page or page size

page.description: Paging state, owned by the host

format.description: Only when 'text' is bound to a non-string value

ComponentTextInput.description: A single text-like value: text, number, email, phone, currency, search or long text.

help.description: Hint shown below the label (not a placeholder)

message.description: Error message shown when validation fails

placeholder.description: Only for kind 'search', shown inside the field. Never a substitute for the label.

size.description: 'hero' for the one number a surface is about (an amount to send): large and centred

action.description: Set when the change applies immediately (a setting); omit inside a Form

ComponentViews.description: Switch between alternative views of the same subject (tabs).

count.description: How many items the view holds, shown beside its label

selected.description: Key of the selected view in host data

variant.description: 'tabs' for sections of a record; 'segmented' for switching how the same thing is shown
